howToUse: corrections[] = claims the adversarial verifier confirmed with a second independent document (plus one partly-refuted claim where the verifier supplied and confirmed the corrected value). Apply these.
needsHumanCheck[] = unverifiable claims and claims confirmed from one source only (mostly ja.wikipedia for discontinued trains). Do not apply without a second source.
refuted[] = claims the verifier disproved. Do not apply; a validator can pin the current value.
structural[] = mechanical high/medium findings from structural-findings.json (no operator check). auditOutcome is set where an audit group resolved the finding.

current = value read from the bundled file at HEAD for the field(s) named; shouldBe = the corrected value or action as stated by the verifier or auditor. shouldBeDerivedFromEvidence=true means the action was derived mechanically from the field text and the current record and should be read with verifierEvidence.
Stops-only policy: times are out of scope (user decision); rows of kind timed-data concern stop lists, train numbers and service ids, not times.
groupWide=true rows apply to every record listed in recordIds.

auditorClaim: The notes are wrong about 宍道. They say 12/16/20号 pass 宍道, but those trains call there. The trains that skip 宍道 are 13, 14, 18 and 22号.
Date-specific exceptions: 29号 and 2号 do not run between 米子 and 出雲市 on stated dates ("１０月２６～２９日・１１月４・５・９～１２・１６～１９日は米子－出雲市間運休").
corrections.verifierEvidence: 12/16/20号 call at 宍道 and 14/18/22号 pass it (11-12). Among the down trains, 13号 passes 宍道. Note: 28/30号 call at 宍道 but pass 玉造温泉.
corrections.claim: 12/16/20号 call at 宍道; 13/14/18/22号 pass
